user.title: EnOcean PTM 216B BLE
user.description: Add the passive EnOcean PTM 216B BLE observer. This creates a single observation-only entry; no pairing, commissioning, or key entry happens here.

reconfigure.title: Manual capture
reconfigure.description: Choose a bounded, manually started capture, or commission/decommission a switch. Setup and passive observation never start any of these on their own.

commission_switch.title: Commission a switch
commission_switch.description: Enter the QR/label text printed on the module, or fill in the address and security key manually. The switch must already be designated (Phase 1.5) in this session; its address must match what you enter here. Never paste this material anywhere except this form -- not into chat, GitHub issues, or Git.

decommission_switch.title: Decommission a switch
decommission_switch.description: Choose a commissioned switch to remove. Its address and security key are permanently deleted from local storage, and its device and entities are removed.

error.invalid_commissioning_data: Could not read an address, security key, and name from the QR/label text or the manual fields. Check the QR text, or fill in the address, the 32-character security key, and a name.

abort.designation_capture_started: Designation capture started. Watch the Designation capture sensor for the baseline, press, and confirmation phases.
abort.evidence_capture_started: Evidence capture started. Watch the Evidence capture sensor during the 90-second collecting window.
abort.no_designated_device: No device has been designated yet in this session. Run designation capture first, then start evidence capture again.
abort.designation_mismatch: The entered address does not match the switch designated in this session. Designate the same physical switch (Phase 1.5) first, then commission it.
abort.commissioning_complete: Switch commissioned. Its button events and diagnostic sensors are now available.
abort.decommissioning_complete: Switch decommissioned. Its device and entities have been removed.
